description: This Java file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It sets up an activity that displays a custom interactive chart view and provides menu options for zooming and panning the chart.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main activity class that hosts an interactive chart view and handles user interactions through menu options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and finds the interactive chart view.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from a menu resource.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to perform zoom and pan actions on the chart view.
